# Asterdex

> Asterdex tracks Aster, a non-custodial exchange for spot and leveraged perpetuals; review markets here, then trade through Aster's verified official app.

## Key facts
- Type: Independent dashboard for a non-custodial perp DEX
- Networks: BNB Chain (56), Ethereum (1), Arbitrum One (42161), Solana; 1001x on BNB Chain + Arbitrum
- Custody: Non-custodial — your wallet signs; USDF strategies add Ceffu custody
- Costs: Trading fee + network gas + perp funding + price impact
- Token in/out: Collateral you post; ASTER is BEP-20 0x000Ae...f556A
- Verify: Domain, chain ID and contract in the live app
